The check fails test 2 (does it discriminate). The transcript shows the command `-W error::DeprecationWarning` already passes today—13 passed, exit 0—even though the second invocation without the flag reveals the warnings are still being emitted. This means the `-W error::DeprecationWarning` flag is not actually promoting those specific `pty.py` warnings to errors on this system, so the check cannot distinguish "done" from "untouched." A discriminating check would fail now (because the warnings exist) and pass only after the fix; this one passes both before and after.
